geometry_interpretation: standard trigonometric/nodal gyroid approximation; not an exact minimal surface or physical metal lattice

geometry.coordinates: x,y,z in centimetres; u,v,w and g,F dimensionless; 0.16 is g-unit half-width
geometry.mesh_policy: marching cubes, watertight triangle mesh, area-weighted smooth vertex normals

deformation.units: P and q in centimetres, t in seconds, k(t) in inverse centimetres, theta dimensionless
deformation.claim_boundary: equations define geometry/deformation/environment inputs; Unreal supplies material, lighting, camera effects and rasterization

environment: procedural HDR studio generated by scripts/make_studio.py
runtime: Unreal Engine 5.7 on Apple silicon M1 Max; software Lumen in the recorded local run
